## Motivation

A unified pool named its longest target window `swa` and every other window `swa_<len>`, so a window's name depended on the other windows a model declares; and the prefix tree, its match/evict API and admission carried at most two windows (`SWA` and `AUXILIARY_SWA`) with dedicated fields. This PR names every window sub-pool by its own lifetime and gives the prefix tree one slot per window sub-pool.

## Modifications

- Names (`mem_cache/kv/plan.py`, `kv/decl.py`, `kv/build.py`, `kv_cache_configurator.py`): every window sub-pool is `window_<len>`, or `window` when the length is not stated. Backends ask for sliding-window layers by role (`KVLayerRouter.plays`) instead of comparing sub-pool names (`kv/router.py`, `routed_cache.py`, `layers/attention/{triton,trtllm_mha,intel_amx}_backend.py`). External names (prefix tree component, host pool, PD state type) are unchanged in this PR.
- Tree slots (`mem_cache/unified_cache/*`, `unified_radix_cache.py`, `base_prefix_cache.py`, `managers/schedule_batch.py`, `prefill_budget.py`): `ComponentType` is an int id with fixed FULL, SWA, MAMBA and C128 ids; a further window registers its own id. `EvictParams.window_num_tokens`, `EvictResult.window_num_tokens_evicted`, `MatchResult.window_host_hit_lengths` and `Req.window_host_hit_lengths` are keyed by tree slot and replace the second-window fields. Host pools and PD keep one further window; a third is refused where the host stack is built and where PD lists its state entries. Static storage maps tree components to sub-pools strictly.
- The Rust tree core keeps one window slot; a tree with several window slots falls back to the Python tree core, logging the reason (`unified_cache/tree_core_registry.py`).
- Buffer-mode pipeline and storage attachment take any number of further window components.
- Tests: `test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_trtllm_mha_unified_window.py`, plus updates to the tree-core registry, prefill adder, multiwindow placement, layout golden (`unified_layout_golden.json`), HiCache and session tests.

**API change:** the `AUXILIARY_SWA` fields of the prefix-cache match/evict API are replaced by per-slot maps. No serving behavior change for current single-window models.

## Accuracy Tests

Serving validation was run at the **top of this 26-PR stack** (the cumulative change), not at this PR's head. Software: torch 2.14.1+cu130, flashinfer 0.7.2, sglang-kernel 0.4.10. GSM8K is few-shot, 500 or 1319 questions as noted; `main` is the same commit the stack is based on, same flags.

| Hardware | Model | Configuration | Stack top | main |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, `--enable-unified-memory` (rebased stack) | 0.954 (1319 q) | 0.950–0.954 |
| 1x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP1, `--enable-unified-memory --max-total-tokens 120000` (rebased stack) | 0.842 (1319 q) | 0.839 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, MTP (EAGLE, 3 steps, topk 1, 4 draft tokens) | 0.951, accept length 3.56 | 0.953, 3.56 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, DFlash draft | 0.951, accept length 5.42 | 0.952, 5.44 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | PD (prefill TP1 + decode TP1, mooncake), unified, repeated runs | 0.952–0.960, no hang | 0.954–0.958 |
| 2x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | PD (TP1 + TP1, mooncake), unified | 0.810 | 0.808 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, HiCache | 0.954 | — |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | PP2, unified | 0.953 | 0.955 (static pools) |
| 2x B200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified (500 q) | 0.958 | 0.960 |

+        )

+            batch_size=len(rows),
+            input_ids=torch.zeros(len(positions), dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+            req_pool_indices=torch.tensor(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+            seq_lens=torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+            seq_lens_cpu=torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32),

+            batch.extend_seq_lens = torch.tensor(

+                (n, _HEADS * _HEAD_DIM), generator=generator, device="cuda"
+            ).to(_DTYPE)

+            else self.backend.forward_extend

+        """A window layer's query at position p reads keys from p - window
+        through p (the kernels' ``window_left``), extend and decode alike."""
+        outputs = []
+        for layer, (q, _, _) in zip(self.layers, inputs):
+            window = layer.sliding_window_size
+            out, start = [], 0
+            for r, p, m in zip(rows, prefix_lens, input_lens):
+                keys, values = self.kv[r][layer.layer_id]
+                for i in range(m):
+                    pos = p + i
+                    first = 0 if window < 0 else max(0, pos - window)
+                    query = q[start + i].view(_HEADS, _HEAD_DIM).float()

+    """A prefix tree keeps one slot per window sub-pool: each window's values,

+
+    def _cache(self):
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.cache_init_params import CacheInitParams

+
+        storage = _storage((16, 8, 4), lazy=False)
+        cache = UnifiedRadixCache(
+            CacheInitParams(
+                disable=False,
+                req_to_token_pool=storage.requests,
+                token_to_kv_pool_allocator=storage.allocator,
+                page_size=4,
+                sliding_window_size=16,
+                tree_slots=storage.tree_slots(),
+                tree_core_backend="python",
+            )
+        )
+        return storage, cache
+
+    def test_each_window_slot_matches_locks_and_evicts_alone(self):
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.base_prefix_cache import (
+            EvictParams,
+            InsertParams,
+            MatchPrefixParams,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.radix_cache import RadixKey
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components import ComponentType
+
+        storage, cache = self._cache()
+        a = storage.allocator
+        swa, swa_8, swa_4 = cache.window_slots()
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [ct.name for ct in (swa, swa_8, swa_4)], ["SWA", "WINDOW_8", "WINDOW_4"]
+        )
+        self.assertIs(swa, ComponentType.SWA)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [(name, ct) for name, ct, _, _ in a.admission_windows(cache)],
+            [("window_16", swa), ("window_8", swa_8), ("window_4", swa_4)],
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [cache.window_retain_size(ct) for ct in (swa, swa_8, swa_4)], [16, 8, 4]
+        )
+
+        key = RadixKey(array("q", range(16)))
+        cache.insert(InsertParams(key=key, value=a.alloc(16).clone()))
+        match = cache.match_prefix(MatchPrefixParams(key=key))
+        self.assertEqual(match.device_prefix_len, 16)
+        node = cache.tree_core.node_by_id(match.last_device_node)
+        for ct in (swa, swa_8, swa_4):
+            self.assertEqual(cache.window_evictable_size(ct), 16)
+            self.assertIsNotNone(node.component_data[ct].value)
+
+        # A lock holds each window slot's own trailing window of the prefix.
+        lock = cache.lock(match.last_device_node)
+        for ct in (swa, swa_8, swa_4):
+            self.assertEqual(node.component_data[ct].lock_ref, 1)

+            [cache.window_evictable_size(ct) for ct in (swa, swa_8, swa_4)],

+        result = cache.evict(EvictParams(window_num_tokens={swa_8: 16, swa_4: 16}))
+        self.assertEqual(result.window_num_tokens_evicted, {swa_8: 8, swa_4: 12})
+        self.assertEqual(

+        )

+        cache.evict(

+    def test_reclaim_evicts_a_further_window_for_its_own_demand(self):
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.base_prefix_cache import InsertParams
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.radix_cache import RadixKey
+

+            key = RadixKey(array("q", range(start, start + 16)))
+            cache.insert(InsertParams(key=key, value=ids.clone()))
+            start += 16
